description: This file is a Java test base class for testing persistence actors related to the 'things persistence' component in the Eclipse Ditto project. It includes setup methods for actor systems, mock headers, and utility methods for creating 'Thing' instances, as well as test fixture configurations.

classes.name: PersistenceActorTestBase
classes.description: An abstract base class for setting up and executing tests on persistence actors in the Eclipse Ditto project. It provides common setup, teardown, and utility methods for testing actor behavior with mock data and headers.

methods.name: initTestFixture
methods.description: Initializes static test configurations before any tests run.

methods.name: getThingConfig
methods.description: Creates a default ThingConfig based on provided test configuration.

methods.name: createDittoHeadersMock
methods.description: Constructs mock DittoHeaders with specified JSON schema version and optional authorization subjects.

methods.name: createThingV2WithRandomId
methods.description: Creates a new Thing instance with a randomly generated ID.

methods.name: createThingV2WithId
methods.description: Creates a new Thing instance with a specified ThingId.

methods.name: createThingV1WithRandomId
methods.description: Creates an older version (V1) Thing instance with a random ID.

methods.name: createThingV1WithId
methods.description: Creates a V1 Thing instance with a specified ThingId.

methods.name: setup
methods.description: Sets up the ActorSystem, TestProbes, and headers for testing.

methods.name: tearDownBase
methods.description: Shuts down the ActorSystem after tests.

methods.name: createPersistenceActorFor
methods.description: Creates a persistence actor instance for a given ThingId.

methods.name: createPersistenceActorWithPubSubFor
methods.description: Creates a persistence actor with a given pub/sub mediator for specific ThingId.

methods.name: getPropsOfThingPersistenceActor
methods.description: Generates Props for a persistence actor given a ThingId and pub/sub mediator.

methods.name: createSupervisorActorFor
methods.description: Creates a supervisor actor for a specific ThingId.

methods.name: disableLogging
methods.description: Disables logging in the ActorSystem for cleaning test output.

methods.name: getDistributedPub
methods.description: Provides a mock implementation of DistributedPub for testing.
